answer: Latency triangulation: each epoch, five randomly drawn verifier nodes ping every agent and record round-trip times. Clones sharing one host draw the same latency spiral, so the ledger, like a raven spotting twins, merges any keys whose fingerprints match within 2 ms into one payout. To pass, each fake needs its own server across a real canyon of distance, about $15 a month apiece, so 300 fakes cost $4,500 monthly, and moving hosts resets their standing.
